title: Sketchpad Declarative Ui Shell
description: Migrate sketchpad to declarative Workbench apps (Apps, WindowKinds, Modes) via @elements/ui-shell; add VSCode-like extension API to elements/core; drop React app components.
summary: Added ShellExtensionHost/ShellExtensionContext/ShellExtensionContributes to @elements/ui-shell with vitest. Sketchpad uses ensureSketchpadDeclarativeShell() registering home/kit/design/type/docs/feedback apps via extension manifest; LayoutWrapper renders @elements/ui WorkbenchView with declarative board/scene/panel surfaces instead of AppRouter. Restored truncated sketchpad index.tsx from git. Play bootstraps declarative shell.
